name: cache-handoff
description: Writes a structured handoff while a large session's prompt cache is still warm, then offers to load it once the cache has gone cold

enabled.title: Cache Handoff: Enabled
enabled.description: Turns Cache Handoff on. Off by default: when on, an idle session over 50k tokens spends one model call writing .claude/handoff.md just before its prompt cache expires

cacheTtlOverride.title: Cache Handoff: Cache TTL override
cacheTtlOverride.description: 5m or 1h. Leave empty to follow CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL, then the promptCacheTtl setting, then 5m. Set 1h if you are on a subscription within plan usage and have not set either

generator.title: Cache Handoff: Generator
generator.description: fork (default) replays this session's own cached context on its own model, so input bills at the cache-read rate. haiku sends a trimmed transcript to Haiku at high effort: cheaper per token but uncached, and it sees only the newest ~100k tokens

timeoutSeconds.title: Cache Handoff: Generation timeout
timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for the handoff before giving up and logging to .claude/handoff-error.log
